features.name: any_comment_two_plus_urls
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain 2 or more URLs?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; if missing or malformed return null; empty list returns 0. For each comment count matches of regex r'https?://\S+|www\.\S+' (each match is one URL occurrence; markdown links count by their URL, duplicates counted). Return 1 if any comment has count >= 2, else 0.

h0: Rows with any_comment_two_plus_urls = 1 have the same delta rate as rows with any_comment_two_plus_urls = 0.
h1: Rows with any_comment_two_plus_urls = 1 have a higher delta rate than rows with any_comment_two_plus_urls = 0.
note: Operational assumptions: persuasiveness is measured by the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view), at row level. The comparison is rows with at least one comment having >=2 URLs vs rows where every comment has 0 or 1 URL (including rows with no comments). Comment-level pairing to the persuaded comment is unavailable (no per-comment outcomes), so this is a row-level association. Regex is mechanical; URLs may appear in quoted text or after-outcome text, and timing is unknown. Not causal.
